Help Center / Support / Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 12, 2026

Tadimaru LLC (the "Company") sets out the following policy on the handling of personal information in services related to "Railway Dispatcher Pro."

1. Information We Collect

The Company may collect the following information through the contact form.

  • Your name
  • Your email address
  • The content of your inquiry

2. Purposes of Use

Personal information we collect is used only for the following purposes.

  • Replying to and handling inquiries
  • Investigating and fixing bugs
  • Improving our services

3. Disclosure to Third Parties

The Company does not provide collected personal information to third parties, except as required by law.

4. Management of Information

The Company strives to prevent the leakage, loss, or damage of collected personal information and manages it appropriately.

5. Deletion of Information

If you request it, we will promptly delete the personal information we have collected about you. To request deletion, please contact us at the address below.

6. Online Co-op Play

In this game's online co-op play, the following information is exchanged between the players playing together through Steam's networking features. It is not sent to the Company's servers, and the Company does not collect or store it.

  • Your Steam display name (shown in the participant list, the operation log, and next to your mouse cursor)
  • Your mouse cursor position, pings, and quick messages
  • The content of your in-game operations and the game state (such as the state of train service)
  • The type of map and timetable being played and a value used to verify them. If the host plays a timetable they made, the data for that timetable (on participants' PCs, it is placed in a temporary folder, used only during that play session, and deleted when the session ends; if the game ends abnormally, it is deleted the next time you join co-op play)

The room code, the game version, the name of the map and timetable being played (for a timetable you made, the name you gave it) and the value used to verify them, and the host's Steam ID are registered with Steam's lobby feature so that rooms can be found. For how information is handled through Steam's networking features, please see Valve Corporation's privacy policy.

In addition, to investigate bugs, during co-op play the PC of the player who created the room (the host) saves a record of operations (the game state at the start, and the content of operations including the display names of the players who performed them), keeping only the most recent portion. If the game state gets out of sync between players, an additional investigation record (the game state at that point) is saved on your own PC. Both are saved in the CoopLogs folder inside the game's data folder. These records are sent to the Company only if you send them yourself, for example in a bug report, and in that case they are handled in accordance with sections 2 to 5 of this policy.

7. Analytics Tools

This support site uses "Google Analytics," provided by Google LLC, to understand how the site is used. Google Analytics uses cookies to collect traffic data, but this traffic data is collected anonymously and does not identify individuals.

You can refuse this collection by disabling cookies, so please check your browser settings. For an explanation of the Google Analytics terms of use, see the Google Analytics Terms of Service page.
